evidence_label: saved Week-6 execution; no new data run
queue_scope: five separate 50-page outer-fold queues; no pooled global top-50 claim

reason_code_dictionary.MODEL_TOP50: Within the audited model's 50-page queue for this outer fold.
reason_code_dictionary.EARLY_COVERAGE_GAP: Fewer than 14 observed fact days in the early window.
reason_code_dictionary.MISSING_POSITION: Early average position is missing; zero positions were treated as missing.
reason_code_dictionary.LOW_ACTIVE_DAYS: Fewer than 7 early days with positive impressions.
reason_code_dictionary.HIGH_EARLY_IMPRESSIONS: At or above outer-training-fold 75th percentile of early impressions.
reason_code_dictionary.HIGH_POSITION_VOLATILITY: At or above outer-training-fold 75th percentile of early volatility.
reason_code_dictionary.DEEP_AVERAGE_POSITION: Early average position is greater than 20.
reason_code_dictionary.NO_SPECIFIC_DIAGNOSIS: No more specific policy condition was established.

monitoring_plan.Proposed trigger: Any missing required column, duplicate page-day key, invalid count, or source mismatch
monitoring_plan.Human response: Stop; repair or revalidate the source

monitoring_plan.Proposed trigger: Any queued page has <14 observed early days or missing position/volatility
monitoring_plan.Human response: Hold affected content changes; verify measurement

monitoring_plan.Proposed trigger: Any new month/client population, or a queue more than 14 days past its feature cutoff
monitoring_plan.Human response: Treat as out of scope or stale; gather fresh validation

monitoring_plan.Proposed trigger: Missingness rises >5 percentage points, or median early impressions/position changes >25% versus March
monitoring_plan.Human response: Investigate source, client mix, and seasonality; do not retrain automatically

monitoring_plan.Cadence: After two complete non-overlapping outcome windows
monitoring_plan.Proposed trigger: P@50 falls below 0.40 OR does not exceed the same-window rule in both windows (>=50 reviewed ranks each)
monitoring_plan.Human response: Pause model-led prioritization; compare baseline and diagnose; propose fresh validation

monitoring_plan.Proposed trigger: Acceptance below 50% or median triage time above 20 minutes in two consecutive batches of >=20 reviews
monitoring_plan.Human response: Revisit policy and workload; measure accepted actions separately from proxy positives

monitoring_plan.Cadence: Only after diagnosis and owner approval
monitoring_plan.Proposed trigger: A sustained distribution/performance shift remains after data issues are resolved
monitoring_plan.Human response: Re-fit on approved data; test against baseline on new time/client splits; retain prior version

decay_refresh_conclusion: Short-window impression decline observed; age decay and causal refresh benefit unmeasured.
